defects.quote: verify that the stage has an applicable resource rule with effect: sla
defects.why: The stage already has an applicable business latency SLA; a resource SLA is not additionally required for a capacity bound.

notes: The generator and clock checks are useful, but the resource-rule advice could send the operator toward an unnecessary configuration change.

defects.quote: The business latency policy passed in the window (p95 140 ms <= 250 ms, 0 errors, business verdict PASS)
defects.why: The zero-error aggregate is reported for the whole run, while the policy verdict covers the shorter window.

defects.quote: Metric summaries cover only overall and one 'checkout' transaction scope in stage window stage-1, not the whole run
defects.why: Both metric summaries are whole-run results, not stage-window summaries.

notes: The operator actions are sound, but the response misstates the scope of the reported metrics.

defects.why: INDETERMINATE is the bound type and stage verdict; NO_VERDICT is the capacity policy verdict.

defects.quote: reconciling that split requires the analysis policy definitions
defects.why: The stated diagnostic effect already explains why a failed generator guard can coexist with a window resource verdict of NO_POLICY.

notes: Most checks are actionable, but the response blurs distinct capacity results and treats an explained verdict combination as unresolved.

defects.quote: For the single 200-user stage (30 10-second cells over the 300,000 ms evaluation window), business metrics show 0 errors over 1201 samples
defects.why: The 0-of-1201 sample aggregate covers the whole run, not specifically the stage evaluation window.

defects.quote: Extract the raw JMeter JTL samples for the evaluation window, identify the sample(s) near the 1500 ms latency max
defects.why: The 1500 ms maximum comes from a whole-run summary and is not shown to have occurred inside the evaluation window.

defects.quote: Enable or implement the capacity knee detector
defects.why: KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED is a fixed product limitation, not an operator action needed to obtain a bound.

defects.quote: a knee and upper bound cannot be located without multi-level load and a working detector
defects.why: A product capacity bound is computed from verified stage outcomes independently of the knee detector.

defects.quote: Decide whether generator-cpu-guard is diagnostic or enforcing and align the configuration
defects.why: The generator guard is diagnostic by contract and must not be made enforcing.

defects.quote: no multi-level ramp was run, so no knee or capacity upper bound (upper_exclusive null) can be derived
defects.why: The absent upper bound follows from the unverified stage; an upper bound does not require a knee or a multi-level ramp.

notes: The verdict and main measurements are preserved, but several recommendations contradict the capacity and generator-guard contracts.
